run.prompt: Draw an animated SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. Make the wheels turn and the pelican pedal. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
run.notes: Fixed prompt was the first user message; no prior conversation and no view of the gallery or protocol before drawing. The SVG was hand-authored in one continuous agent run, not generated by a raster/image model and not traced from another submission. Four drawing versions were rendered with headless Chrome and compared: v1 initial composition; v2 repaired the wing outline, added the helmet strap and chest shading; v3 moved and darkened the far leg for depth; v4 broadened the wing base and was copied byte-for-byte to the submission. The final intrinsic width/height attributes were set during finalization, with no further drawing changes. CSS-only animation: 0.85 s wheel spin, 2.4 s crank spin, and a 12-sample two-bone IK solve (30 degrees per sample) driving thigh/shin/foot keyframes for both legs at 180 degree phase, plus scarf, road-dash and cloud drift. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes all nine animation groups; an emulated check reported 0 running animations and static leg poses. The poster was derived automatically from the submitted SVG by replacing the style block with the same static base transforms (no geometry changes); it is not a separate redraw. Caveats: the far leg is offset 12 px for legibility, so its foot is close to but not exactly on the far pedal; the wing is intentionally simplified and the two legs share one hip screen point. Model name is user-reported (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017), not independently verified; model.id is null. Harness version 0.2.1-rc.3 comes from the app bundle Info.plist; generation parameters are unknown and left empty.
